features:
Stand script for dahood free and keyless Commands:

Repair! - Fix the bot if glitched
Summon! - summons your stand
Rejoin! - Bot rejoin the game
v! - Teleports bot to the void
d! "username" - Knock's target
s! "username" - Stomp's target
b! "username" - Brings target
l! "username" - Loopskill target
lk! "username" - Loopsknock target
sky! "username" - Teleports target to void 
say! "message" - Make's bot say in chat
Cashdrop on! / off! - Bot drop cash
Abuse on! / off! - Abuses void
Sentry on! / off! -  Bot make's you untouchable
Bsentry on! / off! - Gives bot sentry ( Must be using sentry on! too for it to work )
swl! / unswl! - Whitelist / UnWhiteLists person from sentry
search! - bots whitelists eachother ( if u use multiple bots they dont kill eachother )
t! "player 1" "player 2" - teleports 1st player to 2nd one
tp! "location": rifle, armor, lmg, mil, rev, food, food2, roof, bank, school, rpg - Bots take you to the specified location


a on! / off! -  Make bot spin around you and shoot nearby ppl
awl! / unawl! - Whitelists person from being shoot while your bots are spinning

wl! / unwl! "username" - Allows / Disallows player to use your bot
